tasks.description: 1.1 Implement bounded pinned-tokenizer length audit and full-phase input export; verify special-token boundaries, ID/text integrity, phase isolation, immutable outputs and batch ordering with tests.

1.3 Measure selected-cap GPU feasibility, freeze a separate final recipe and generate complete real preference/routing caches; verify dimensions, norms, coverage, lineage and resume.
2.1 Inspect original RouterBench/PILOT sources and pinned converter history; publish evidence for shot/release/task discrepancies and remaining three model bridges, with unresolved items explicit.
2.2 Implement evidence-backed historical price/token-count inputs and triplet cost order; verify units, counts, tuning-only response estimates and failure on missing provenance.
2.3 Freeze protocol configuration and document paper differences, model pools and resource estimates; verify no deployment outcomes influence chosen settings.

3.2 Add tuning-only parameter selection for PILOT and baselines; verify selected settings survive deployment-label mutation and persist all candidate scores.

4.2 Run a small real prior-learning-deployment integration; independently read back artifacts and verify no synthetic input is admitted.
4.3 Run full approved-pool learning, deployment budgets, MMLU subset and declared seeds sequentially; verify complete run inventory and publish aggregate metrics with deviations.
5.1 Run declared prior/cost/embedding or data-size ablations under identical splits; verify paired comparisons and document uncertainty and incomplete conditions.
5.2 Generate figures, research report and poster from completed real run manifests; verify figures against tables and label substitutions and limits accurately.
5.3 Verify the final reproduction commands, full regression suite and data/config hashes; update handoff and remaining-work inventory without calling unresolved research complete.
